title: Kit Presets
description: A simple minecraft mod that adds kit loaders to you game
body:
Inventory Saver

Inventory Saver is a simple Fabric client-side mod that lets you save, organize, and reload inventory presets quickly. It is made for players who swap between kits, building setups, tools, armor, or different loadouts and want an easy way to manage them without rebuilding their inventory every time.

Features

* Save your current inventory as a preset
* Create named preset folders
* Clean in-game UI for managing presets
* Quick preset selection menu
* Organized layout that supports more presets as your list grows
* Client-side focused and lightweight
* Built for Fabric 1.21.11

How It Works

Open the preset menu, create a new preset, name it, and save your current inventory setup. You can then return to the menu later and select the preset whenever you want to use that setup again.

This is useful for:

* PvP kits
* Building inventories
* Mining setups
* Redstone tools
* Event/loadout presets
* Creative mode organization

Controls

The mod includes an in-game menu for creating and selecting presets. The default keybind Kit Presets is "i".

Requirements

* Minecraft 1.21.11
* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API

Notes

This mod is designed to stay simple and clean. It does not try to add complicated systems or extra gameplay mechanics. It just helps you save and manage inventory setups faster.
